name: voice
description: Plain replies backed by evidence: strips filler and AI tells from the model's text, and flags factual claims that cite no file:line, command output or URL

slopFilter.title: Slop filter
slopFilter.description: Remove praise openers, closers and filler words from the model's text before it is stored.

mode.title: Filter mode
mode.description: rewrite edits the stored text; flag only counts what it would have changed.

extraPhrases.title: Extra banned phrases
extraPhrases.description: Comma-separated phrases to delete, or /regex/flags entries. Example: leverage, /\bseamless(ly)?\b/i

audit.title: Evidence auditor
audit.description: After a long answer about code or systems, ask a small model which claims cite no file:line, command output or URL.

auditModel.title: Auditor model
auditModel.description: Model alias or id for the audit call.

auditMinLength.title: Audit minimum length
auditMinLength.description: Answers shorter than this many characters are never audited.
